title: Customer agreement and follow-up notes
summary: The fragments are brief service-process notes about customers agreeing to proposed actions, explanations, scans, emails, photos, or follow-up timing, without enough context to determine evaluative sentiment.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments describe customer agreement with service steps and planned follow-up, but they do not provide enough context to judge satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: All sampled fragments are classified as undetermined, so no sentiment-specific comparison is possible.
The examples are short administrative notes and often lack enough context to infer customer sentiment.
The cluster centers on service communication and follow-up actions rather than a clearly defined vehicle issue.
